newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan dollar ends slightly up on overseas trend.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan dollar ends slightly up on overseas trend.

text.p: The Taiwan dollar closed slightly higher against its U.S. counterpart on Wednesday, reflecting the greenback's mild weakness overseas against the Japanese yen, dealers said.
The local unit ended at T$27.494 against Tuesday's T$27.500 close. Turnover through dealers was a light US$123.5 million.
Selling of the U.S. dollar came mainly from foreign commercial banks but the overall impact was relatively muted, dealers said.
"The balance of trade remains pretty stable and big movements are very unlikely in the near future," said one dealer at a foreign bank.
A T$27.48-50 range was seen for Thursday.
